= Map Lengths for Story Mode =

== Overview: ==
This Page is meant for Finding the Longest and Shortest Maps, and for information of which Map is the best for AFK Gem Farming using Infinite Mode.

To measure the Map Length, walking speed is used, and starting from the top of the NPC Path , and ending to where the NPC Path Ends. The Seconds are approximate, But the Gems, and the Minutes are Not.
